thought.text: CATALINA_PID was globally exported, so the other two instances saw dienste's PID file. Let me start them with per-instance PID files:

reasoning_content: The CATALINA_PID environment variable I set was being applied globally to all three startup scripts (because it was exported), so all of them were checking the same PID file at /opt/tomcat-dienste/tomcat.pid. Only Dienste-Tomcat actually started up. I need to properly set CATALINA_PID individually for each instance and restart anwendung and api.

action.command:
unset CATALINA_PID
source /etc/xplanbox.env
CATALINA_PID=/opt/tomcat-anwendung/tomcat.pid /opt/tomcat-anwendung/bin/startup.sh
sleep 3
CATALINA_PID=/opt/tomcat-api/tomcat.pid /opt/tomcat-api/bin/startup.sh
sleep 5
ps aux | grep "[c]atalina.home" | awk '{print $2}' | while read p; do tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$p/cmdline | grep -o "catalina.base=[^ ]*" | sed "s/^/pid $p: /"; done
